lessons.title: Reading: A Day in Tashkent
lessons.context: A short passage about an ordinary weekday.

paragraphs.uz: Mening ismim Dilnoza. Men Toshkentda yashayman.
paragraphs.en: My name is Dilnoza. I live in Tashkent.

paragraphs.uz: Har kuni ertalab soat yettida turaman.
paragraphs.en: Every morning I wake up at seven.
I have breakfast and go to work.
During the day work is very busy.

paragraphs.uz: Kechqurun uyga qaytaman va oilam bilan ovqatlanaman.
paragraphs.en: In the evening I return home and eat with my family.

paragraphs.uz: Dam olish kunlari do'stlarim bilan uchrashaman.
paragraphs.en: On rest days I meet with my friends.

questions.question: U dam olish kunlari nima qiladi?
